import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_K = 32;
    
    static long n;
    static int k;
    
    static class Matrix {
        int[][] data;
        
        Matrix(int size) {
            data = new int[size][size];
        }
        
        void initIdentity() {
            for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < data.length; j++) {
                    data[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        void initZero() {
            for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < data.length; j++) {
                    data[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        Matrix copy() {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(data.length);
            for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < data.length; j++) {
                    res.data[i][j] = data[i][j];
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }
    
    static Matrix[][] base_matrices = new Matrix[62][MAX_K];
    
    static int add(int a, int b) {
        a += b;
        if (a >= MOD) a -= MOD;
        return a;
    }
    
    static int mul(int a, int b) {
        return (int)(((long)a * b) % MOD);
    }
    
    static Matrix multiply(Matrix A, Matrix B) {
        int size = A.data.length;
        Matrix C = new Matrix(size);
        C.initZero();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < size; t++) {
                    C.data[i][j] = add(C.data[i][j], mul(A.data[i][t], B.data[t][j]));
                }
            }
        }
        return C;
    }
    
    static boolean readInput() {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (scanner.hasNextLong()) {
            n = scanner.nextLong();
            k = scanner.nextInt();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static void process() {
        List<Integer> digits = new ArrayList<>();
        long temp = n;
        while (temp > 0) {
            digits.add((int)(temp % k));
            temp /= k;
        }
        
        // Initialize base_matrices[0][d]
        for (int d = 0; d < k; d++) {
            base_matrices[0][d] = new Matrix(k + 1);
            base_matrices[0][d].initIdentity();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                base_matrices[0][d].data[i][d] = 1;
            }
        }
        
        // Process higher levels
        for (int level = 1; level < digits.size(); level++) {
            List<Matrix> prefix = new ArrayList<>();
            Matrix identity = new Matrix(k + 1);
            identity.initIdentity();
            prefix.add(identity);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                Matrix next = multiply(prefix.get(i), base_matrices[level - 1][i]);
                prefix.add(next);
            }
            
            for (int shift = 0; shift < k; shift++) {
                base_matrices[level][shift] = prefix.get(0).copy();
                for (int i = 0; i < k - shift; i++) {
                    base_matrices[level][shift] = multiply(base_matrices[level][shift], base_matrices[level - 1][(i + shift) % k]);
                }
                base_matrices[level][shift] = multiply(base_matrices[level][shift], prefix.get(shift));
            }
        }
        
        Matrix dp = new Matrix(k + 1);
        dp.initZero();
        dp.data[0][k] = 1;
        
        int remainder = 0;
        for (int i = digits.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int digit = digits.get(i);
            while (digit > 0) {
                dp = multiply(dp, base_matrices[i][remainder]);
                remainder = (remainder + 1) % k;
                digit--;
            }
        }
        
        int result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            result = add(result, dp.data[0][i]);
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (scanner.hasNextLong()) {
            n = scanner.nextLong();
            k = scanner.nextInt();
            process();
        }
    }
}
